data.name: Mannu
data.gender_notes: Mannu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mannu is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'manas', which means 'mind' or 'intellect'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to have great potential and intelligence. In Hindu mythology, the god Manas is the embodiment of the mind and intellect. The name Mannu carries the meaning “Mind, Intellect” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mannu usually hope their child will grow to embody mind, intellect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mannu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mind, Intellect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mannu total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
